swapfile="/swapfile"
swapsize="10G"

if [ "$check_swap" -lt 2 ]; then
       echo "enable swap"
       # create swap file
       [ -f "$swapfile" ] || sudo fallocate -l "$swapsize" "$swapfile"
       # make the file only accessible to root
       sudo chmod 600 "$swapfile"
       # mark the file as swap space
       sudo mkswap "$swapfile"
       # enable swap
       sudo swapon "$swapfile"
       # Values that are closer to 100 will try to put more data into swap
       # in an effort to keep more RAM space free
       #
       # set the value close to zero
       sudo sysctl vm.swappiness=10
fi
# check swap
sudo swapon --show
